name: Greenpanel Industries Ltd
title: Greenpanel Industries Ltd - 542857 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Greenpanel FY26 reported EBITDA fell to 6.3% with PBT -INR43.8 crore; management gave no FY27 margin or volume guidance, citing Middle East chemical cost shock, a 15% price hike being discounted, and 40-45% chemical cost inflation.

utilisation.quote: we operated at 60% capacity utilization in quarter four FY '26

capex.peers_comment: Management noted peers' new capacity (Greenply, Century Ply) and industry additions of about 400,000 cubic metres in the second half of FY27 without commenting on their discipline.
capex.quote: I would say that in this year, there would deﬁnitely be no plans of signiﬁcant capex announcement.

triggers.label: No FY27 margin or volume guidance
triggers.quote: We want to sit out the ﬁrst quarter, wait and watch till we give you a deﬁnitive guidance on where we will stand.

triggers.label: 15% price hike already discounted
triggers.quote: we are already seeing slight discounting already happening in the market from that 15%

triggers.label: Industry capacity additions in H2 FY27
triggers.quote: the total size that we are looking at is 400,000 for the full year

triggers.label: Utilisation 60% in Q4 FY26
triggers.quote: we operated at 60% capacity utilization in quarter four FY '26

triggers.label: DSO 11 → 21 days
triggers.quote: something which was 11 days in FY '25 has gone up to 21 days now

guidance.value: With the market or better; industry early double digit to mid-teens
guidance.quote: we are going to be with the market or better than the market.

guidance.value: Maintain or improve; no numeric guidance
guidance.quote: The intent would be to maintain or even take this up.
something between INR20 crore-INR30 crore, not more at this point in time.

prior_guidance_check.metric: FY26 volume and EBITDA in line with revised guidance (Nov 2025)
prior_guidance_check.quote: our full year volume numbers are still broadly in line with the revised guidance that we had shared middle of last year.

red_flags.label: Reported PAT negative INR29.1 crore FY26
red_flags.quote: the PAT was negative INR29.1 crore

red_flags.label: DSO rose from 11 to 21 days
red_flags.quote: something which was 11 days in FY '25 has gone up to 21 days now

red_flags.label: Price hike discounting by peers
red_flags.quote: we are already seeing slight discounting already happening in the market from that 15%

evasions.quote: We want to be very cautious in giving a margin guidance at this point of time
it is not fair to say that that thin MDF line is only for thin MDF
